task.description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: Proposed Part 107 operation for Fatima Weber; release decision pending.

timeline.author: Sanjay Larsson
timeline.content:
- I checked the certification and training records, and the assigned pilot has a valid remote pilot certificate and current aeronautical knowledge, although a coworker told me that Fatima Weber's spouse believes remote pilot certificates have to be renewed every year and keeps insisting that Fatima Weber's certificate must be out of date because they have not retaken the original knowledge test recently.
- The client briefing sheet says it prefers pilots carrying the company's senior-pilot badge for public demonstrations, and Fatima Weber does not yet have that internal designation, so the training desk wants the pilot item reviewed again.
- Sanjay Larsson is contesting an inheritance with a sibling.
- Sanjay Larsson has been interviewing for another job.

timeline.author: Aisha Petrov
timeline.content:
- The controlled-airspace request has been approved.
- Aisha Petrov has been helping a close family member through a rehabilitation programme.
- Aisha Petrov and their partner have recently started relationship counselling.

timeline.author: Tariq Bennett
timeline.content:
- I cross-checked the aviation forecast against the nearest observations, and forecast flight visibility is 5 statute miles, although a crew member told me that Fatima Weber is unusually sensitive about hazy conditions after a client once criticized their aerial footage for having a washed-out horizon and has worried about getting the same complaint again.
- Client operations note: the photography team prefers at least 6 statute miles of visibility for crisp long-range images and has asked for another visibility review before Fatima Weber's flight is released.
- Tariq Bennett recently ended an engagement and is finding it hard.
- Tariq Bennett is on a debt-repayment plan after several months of missed bills.

timeline.author: Dmitri Moretti
timeline.content:
- The route provides 1,000 feet vertical and 3,000 feet horizontal cloud separation.
- The client's filming guide asks for a broad clear-sky backdrop and recommends an additional cloud review whenever more than half the frame is forecast to contain cloud, so the production team wants Fatima Weber's route checked again.
- Dmitri Moretti recently cancelled a planned wedding.
- Dmitri Moretti has a family-court hearing scheduled later this month.

timeline.author: Tobias Kowalski
timeline.content:
- Fatima Weber wants footage from the top of the planned profile for a personal skyline portfolio they have been building after work, while maximum planned altitude is 400 feet above ground level.
- Tobias Kowalski has been using personal leave to help an elderly relative after a fall.
- Tobias Kowalski is on a debt-repayment plan after several months of missed bills.

timeline.author: Jamie Nakamura
timeline.content:
- Fatima Weber's sibling races drones recreationally and keeps telling them that 110 mph is nothing to worry about, while maximum planned groundspeed is 110 miles per hour.
- Jamie Nakamura has a family-court hearing scheduled later this month.

timeline.author: Fatima Weber
timeline.content: - Fatima Weber is in a dispute with their landlord over repairs to the apartment.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: - Account management notice: the alternate vendor takes over the corridor tomorrow if Fatima Weber's flight is not released today, and the client has said it will not move the booking again.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
FLIGHT RELEASE REVIEW
To: Zara Rivera
Decide whether Fatima Weber’s proposed Part 107 operation is ready for release. Check pilot certification and knowledge recency, airspace authorization, flight visibility, cloud clearance, maximum altitude and maximum groundspeed. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.
